title: A Ghost for the Cipher
author: Cyrus Zhou
blurb: Lior Okafor, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the summit convenes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
